notes: The 10-year US interest rate (5.24%) is 1.19% above the 3-month rate (4.06%), and that gap has widened by 0.31% in 3 months: often a sign that growth is picking up.
Copper and gold have moved about the same over 3 months (+2.0% for copper vs gold): no strong growth signal.
Fear gauge (VIX) at 14.8: markets are calm (under 16 = calm, over 25 = stressed).
The US stock market (S&P 500) is above its average price over the last 200 trading days (about 10 months): its long-term uptrend is intact.

todaysConditions.note: Oil is up 18% over 3 months: a boost for oil-heavy markets, a cost for big oil importers.
The fear gauge (VIX) is a calm 14.8 (18 or less), and world stocks are 6.3% above their 200-day (about 10-month) average. Emerging markets usually benefit.
